change: Fit tab widths to actual icon/title content

policy.measurement: Cached text measurement with matching font weight, icon slot and padding
policy.allocation: Short titles stop at natural width; spare width goes to other labels; hidden labels collapse to compact icon slots

Hidden labels never leave oversized icon slots
Overflow selection, viewport resize, stacked icons and drag reorder
scope: Android tab layout only; no terminal font sizing, native transport or server changes
